title: Ruins & the Night Train Home
description: Drop back down the valley to explore Roman ruins and a hilltop cathedral, then drop the car in Montréjeau and take the overnight train back to Paris.

activities.name: Cathédrale Sainte-Marie

activities.name: Roman ruins of Lugdunum Convenarum
